profile.headline: Mobile Software Developer / Architect
profile.summary:
Dynamic leader of software development teams offering 15+ years of experience managing mission-critical projects.  Skilled in all phases of the software development lifecycle; expert in translating business requirements into technical solutions; and fanatical about quality, usability, security and scalability.  

Technology Summary:

Stack Development: Javascript + Bootstrap / Materialize + AngularJS, NodeJS + Express + MongoDB

Mobile Development: Objective-C (or Swift)+ SocketRocket (WebSockets for iOS) + Python + Google Cloud Datastore, NodeJS

Cloud Platforms: Good Cloud platform, OpenShift by RedHat

Containers: Docker

Languages: Objective-C (5 years), Swift(1 year), Python (4 years), Java (15 years), Javascript (15 years), HTML 3/4/5 (7 years), C, C++, RPG/400

Development Tools, Methodologies & Environments:  Continuous Integration and Test Driven Development, Agile, Rapid Application Design (RAD), Integrated Software Development, Microsoft Visual Studio

Other Applications Servers:  Express, Tomcat, IBM WebSphere MQ, Apache, iPlanet, JBoss, BEA WebLogic

OS: Linux, OS X, iOS, Unix, Windows

Databases:  Mongodb, GCP Datastore, Oracle, SQL Server, Posgre SQL, MYSQL, SQL/400

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer / Founder
positions.description:
Tap2Run is a mobile application consulting and software development company.  

- Designed, developed and deployed several mobile software applications; iOS and responsive front end apps.
- Leveraged cloud computing services from Google and OpenShift by RedHat.
- Utilized full stack development: Bootstrap / Materialize + AngularJS front end and NodeJS + Express + MongoDB on back end. 
- Developed native iOs apps connected to cloud services via REST and JSON payloads.
- Developed successful real time response apps leveraging HTML WebSockets.

One mobile application includes: 

GameReporter Volleyball Edition (www.gamereporterapp.com) - Live play by play sports reporting and viewing iOS app.   Multi-tab app interface allows users to report games play by play while simultaneously viewing other games in progress.  Easy and intuitive UI provides score flipping and single button pre-configured messages with expressions and actions.  

VolleyReporter (www.volleyreporter.com) - WIP.  A responsive webapp version of GameReporter for iOS and Android users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served as lead Architect and developer of ADP EHRMS Integration Tool suite. 
- Designed and implemented tools and database schemas to support integration between disparate systems via XML based BODs.
- Championed the effort to replace aging Java Swing EHRMS tool suite with a next generation design based on the Eclipse RCP plugin architecture.  
- Implemented new features for multiple releases of the EHRMS application server.
- Designed and implemented migration strategy to support ADP's Internet Security Infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Lead architect responsible for the design and implementation of one of EzGov's top products, the Business Rules Engine (BRE).  Designed as a general purpose rules engine and state machine, BRE was capable of running syntax validation rules as well as scripted business rules over one or many data containers.   

- Lead a team of engineers responsible for design and implementation of EzGov's Business Rules Builder tool.
- Designed with partners EDS and Microsoft Tax Payer's inbox messaging functionality for the British Pay-As-You-Earn (PAYE) tax system.
- Designed and implemented server side Ant deployment scripts and UI tools for the E-forms online forms.

positions.title: Architect/Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
B2B e-commerce software startup.  Member of the team responsible for charting technological direction and delivery of system architecture based on high-level requirements and company vision. 

- Led a team of 6 software engineers on a successful implementation and deployment of the company's first beta site and customer of eeParts, an electronic surplus parts marketplace. 
- Designed and led a team of 15 developers on the implementation of J2EE e-commerce app server capable of supporting thousands of concurrent users.  Heavy EJB, both session and entity beans (BMP) deploying on BEA WebLogic 5.1 app server and Oracle 8i.
- Managed full, iterative product life-cycles from requirements to use cases, to building project plans, Object Oriented design, implementation, design and code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment. 
- Performed technical analysis, evaluation, prototypes and recommendations of 3rd party commercial J2EE app servers (iPlanet, WebLogic, JBOSS, Orion, JOnAS,Enhydra).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer of enterprise business application software solutions. 

- Performed detailed technical analysis of proposed Java architectures and made technical recommendations for future versions of Mapics ERP applications.
- Developed an expert level understanding of the Java Platform and Enterprise Java Beans 1.0 specification.
- Served as Project Manager and Lead Engineer for C++ project, integrating ERP subsystems; Symix Advance Planning and Scheduling engine and Mapics ERP application.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Smalltalk and JAVA development.  5+ years experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Advance Planning and Scheduling (APS) systems.  Participated in full software development lifecycle for the CA-QRE product; advanced shop floor scheduling engine based on scheduling Theory of Constraints algorithms. 

- Served as lead developer on a re-engineer and re-implementation project of CA-QRE from Smalltalk Windows NT platform to Java 1.1.
- Designed and implemented legacy integration layer; IBM AS/400 and Windows NT platforms.
- Participated in a number of beta site deployments of CA-QRE.  Responsible for on-site beta implementations, documenting the user experience and customer suggestions, and resolving gaps.
- Participated actively in multi-company cooperative efforts with IBM defining AS/400 JAVA requirements and business object design requirements ("Partners in Development Summit").
